1005007001.name: Daniel Cohen
1005007001.text: Charges my iPhone 15 and Galaxy S23 fast. The magnet aligns perfectly and the build quality feels premium for the price.

1005007001.name: Sarah L.
1005007001.text: Great charger, but the LED indicator is a bit bright on the nightstand. Otherwise solid value.

1005007001.name: Mike Tavor
1005007001.text: Shipped within a week to Tel Aviv. Works with my case on — very convenient.

1005007002.name: Emma Roth
1005007002.text: Surprisingly good bass and the ear hooks stay put during runs. Battery lasts my whole workout week.

1005007002.name: David Peretz
1005007002.text: Sound is clear, pairing is instant. The case is a little bulky for pockets but fine for a gym bag.

1005007002.name: Noa Barak
1005007002.text: Best budget sport earbuds I have tried. Microphone quality on calls is way better than expected.

1005007003.name: Alex Goren
1005007003.text: Perfect for fixing phones and laptops. The magnetic mat keeps screws from disappearing.

1005007003.name: Yael Mizrahi
1005007003.text: Bought it for my husband and he uses it constantly. Bits are high quality and the handle is comfortable.

1005007003.name: Ron Levine
1005007003.text: Comprehensive kit. Only wish it included a torque driver, but for the price it is unbeatable.
